name: adaptive_farthest_ruin_recreate
thought: Hybrid solver using farthest-first seed selection and cheapest insertion for initial construction (from parent1), followed by local search (relocate, swap, 2-opt) with deterministic tie-breaking. When local search plateaus, an adaptive ruin-recreate perturbs the solution: it removes the farthest customers (by distance to depot) from the longest route, with removal size starting at 1 and increasing up to 3 on failure, resetting on improvement. Repair uses regret-2 insertion. This preserves the backbone of construction + local search + perturbation while changing the ruin criterion and construction method.
